_comment: Editable takeoff rules (Todd, 2026-09-07: 'hard rules need to be edited somehow'). The sidecar reads this file at start; pass --rules <file> to use another. Every key is optional; missing keys keep the defaults shown here.

columns._pier: added to the elevation note when no T/PLINTH or TOP OF FOOTING note gives the depth (columns bolt to the pier cap below the finished slab)
columns._height: the highest elevation note within this many feet on the structural plans is the column top

members._extend: how far a free member end reaches to the line it frames into on a plan
members._skip: EX. / (E) / EXISTING members get no markup at all (EX means existing, never exterior)
members._holes: 'aisc' = AISC Part 10 rows-by-depth default until the connection category templates carry Berger's counts; 'none' = write no holes

elevations._measure: measure a structural elevation only when its members carry sizes (braced frames, bracing, trusses); sections and details never
elevations._extend: chord-to-chord reach for a brace end
elevations._quantity: every member in an elevation carries Quantity = the grids its title lists ('TRUSS ELEVATION AT GRID 1,2,3 & 4' = 4); the count rides on each member, not on one representative line

typicals._quantity: a typical unit (a detail / elevation reused N times) is written once with Quantity = N on each member - Todd's own convention when a plan only counts units (Weslayan crown); set false to prefer one markup per piece

deck._areas: one starting area polygon per framed drawing as item 2 (grating item 3); never on foundation / pier / slab sheets
